title: Fixed Curved Heel and Raised Truss Bridge
description: One independently authored complete fixed rolling-heel-style opening-bridge exterior. Two full ground piers carry short flat bearing rails. Two entire thick curved heel sectors, each with actual inner opening and three full spokes, meet those rails at their low faceted soles and join a complete transverse hub. One broad raised deck with full side trusses and underfloor crossbearers extends forward from that hub. Two whole rear upper arms carry one complete crosswise counterweight appearance, while a low fixed rear approach ties the two piers. The curved heel-to-short-flat-track support is new full geometry: no overhead towers or rope paths, no anchored gate-leaf root pivot, and no central turning table. Unlike the old twin-tower lift bridge the entire span is inclined and its support is local to the rear; unlike the old masonry drawbridge gateway there is no enclosing portal or high rope routing. All geometry newly authored, no old bridge imported, scaled or reduced. Four opaque constant PBR roles, metre Z up and full horizontally centred ground datum; one complete static architectural equipment model zero scenes. Deliberate fixed embedded joints and small bearing overlaps are artistic support appearances, not functional rolling contact or an engineered mechanism. No terrain, river, vehicle, person, actual opening path, balance, gear engagement, traffic passage, waterway clearance, load, installation, manufacture or civil/safety performance. Rigging animation interaction not made.
